candidates.name: r3-I full
candidates.role: full anode-transport+kinetic package on H: t+ 0.45->0.55 (high-t+ concentrated/fluorinated electrolyte class, literature direction), anode porosity 0.35->0.40 (AMVF 0.65->0.60 consistent) with anode thickness 110->120 um to hold the anode capacity margin (H measured 1C capacity dropped 5.743->5.602 Ah: AMVF 0.65 anode became near-limiting -> compensate thickness; 120 um x 0.60 keeps ~equal capacity margin and ~equal anode layer mass), graphite particles 3.0->2.5 um (+20% kinetic area, shorter solid-diffusion path), separator 8->6 um (ultrathin ceramic-coated class). Targets the remaining ~15 mV of anode-side eta at the 4.2 V cut-off (H min -0.0149 V).

candidates.name: r3-J light
candidates.role: minimal touch on H: t+ 0.55 + particles 2.5 um only. Isolates the kinetic + concentration-polarization contribution; keeps H's capacity margin intact.

candidates.name: r3-K mid
candidates.role: H + t+ 0.55 + anode porosity 0.40 with thickness compensation 110->120 um (capacity margin preserved). Isolates the anode-pore transport contribution without touching separator or particle kinetics.

candidates.name: r3-L sep
candidates.role: H + t+ 0.55 + separator 6 um. Isolates the separator ohmic/concentration-path contribution.

llm_reason: Round-2 verdicts (all fail on plating; DFN authoritative): E sigma 1.8: min -0.1309 V; F +t+ 0.45: -0.0365 V (t+ is the dominant lever); G +h 100: Tmax 328.3 K PASS, min -0.0473; H +sep 8 um + porosity 0.35: Tmax 327.4 PASS, min -0.0149 V (15 mV short). H's minimum sits at the 4.2 V cut-off after a smooth decline from +0.083 V at charge start (crosses zero at V=4.118 V) -> the remaining gap is a slowly growing anode-side eta vs U_anode deficit through the last third of the charge; target the remaining ~15 mV with anode-side concentration + kinetic levers. Measured side effect: H's 1C capacity fell 5.743->5.602 Ah (AMVF 0.65 anode became near-limiting), so porosity increase in round 3 is paired with anode thickness 110->120 um (deviation from the round-2 reserve note which floated 95-100 um: the measured capacity drop inverts the direction - anode needs MORE margin, not less; recorded here per no-silent-drift rule). All values declared before running: t+ 0.55 = concentrated/fluorinated-electrolyte domain estimate; separator 6 um = ultrathin ceramic-coated class; porosity 0.40/AMVF 0.60, thickness 120 um, particles 2.5 um = architecture choices (widest DOF); sigma stays 1.8 S/m (upper literature edge; pushing beyond would strain the estimate); h stays 100. Names per PyBaMM parameter set (run-pyamm validates).
